description: Short public introductions printed on name badges: who each character is, without giving away secrets. The Vincent/Peter introduction is split across two badges by export_snapshot.py.

Vincent Vale / Peter Vale.description: Vincent is the charismatic founder of Vale Meridian Studios. After his dramatic demise, his suave and calculating twin Peter arrives to take his place in the spotlight.

Veronica Vane.description: Once adored by millions, Veronica has returned to the screen with perfect hair, immaculate glamour and rather more at stake than she cares to admit.

Inspector Donna Reed.description: An off-duty detective who never truly clocks off. Calm, procedural and difficult to distract once the evening takes a suspicious turn.

Dakota Steele.description: Discreet, observant and methodical. Dakota notices movements, objects and timings that pass everyone else by.

Cassie Chase.description: Money, glamour and a famously short fuse. Cassie wears her feelings openly, but she is far sharper than her reputation suggests.

Crystal DeVille.description: A polished and ruthless career-maker who has spent decades deciding who gets access to fame and who is left waiting outside.

Dr. Beverly Steele.description: Authoritative, expensive and accustomed to being the most knowledgeable person in the room, Beverly arrives with professional confidence and a discreet medical bag.

Scooter.description: Quick, capable and easily overlooked. Scooter moves through crowded rooms delivering packages and hearing far more than people realise.

Roxy Riot.description: Vale Meridian's former voice of rebellion, now colder, darker and more theatrical. Roxy can still make a room feel like a live stage.

Rex 'Razor' Steele.description: A pyrotechnic rock veteran with a reputation for spectacular performances, damaged dressing rooms and very loud opinions.

Robbie Rayne.description: Once the smiling face of Take Watt, Robbie is now a guarded solo artist trying to keep the reunion atmosphere professionally cheerful.

Nikki Neon.description: A bright, ambitious backing singer with sharp instincts, stage discipline and every intention of being remembered after the final chorus.

Angie Vixen.description: The dramatic face of cult horror: expressive, theatrical and never afraid to turn a tense moment into a scene worth watching.

Roxie Runway.description: Runway glamour with a carefully guarded private life. Roxie understands that appearances are valuable and secrets even more so.

Larry Loveboat.description: A velvet-voiced entertainer who treats every conversation as an intimate cabaret and every entrance as the start of a new number.

Chuck Chambers.description: Loud, charismatic and professionally fascinated by confrontation. Chuck can turn the smallest rumour into an hour of television.

Brenda Blip.description: Energetic, connected and always listening. Brenda knows how to read a room through a pair of headphones and recognise a scoop when she hears one.

DJ Spinny T.description: A former pirate broadcaster who can control the mood of a room with impeccable timing, the right record and a well-placed distraction.

Frankie Faith.description: Immaculate, reassuring and permanently camera-ready. Frankie projects moral authority with all the polish of a prime-time broadcast.

Tina Tanktop.description: A relentlessly upbeat fitness celebrity whose VHS empire combines Lycra, positive thinking and the promise of a completely new you.

Lola Lasalle.description: A disciplined celebrity trainer who turned workouts into a home-video phenomenon and knows how to keep smiling under pressure.

Cassette Carl.description: Streetwise and resourceful, Carl moves in circles where secrets have market value and information is currency.

Lady Helena de Brissac.description: Charismatic, pious and influential, Helena is used to commanding attention and trust while noticing the details others miss.

Leo Lights.description: A lighting professional with an eye on the next rung of the ladder. Leo understands cues, power and what should happen when a switch is thrown.

Sheila Sparks.description: Practical, technically minded and watchful. Sheila notices when equipment, service or backstage arrangements do not follow the expected pattern.

Fiona Fringe.description: An architect of the unmistakable 1980s silhouette. Fiona reads clothes like evidence and spots alterations that nobody else would notice.

Ronnie Reels.description: A driven director with a visual memory, relentless deadlines and a habit of observing the details outside the centre of the frame.

Vance Vellum.description: Charming, perceptive and rarely without a Polaroid. Vance knows that an unguarded moment makes a much better story than a posed portrait.

Sabrina Sinclair.description: A sharp reporter from the News of the Screws, equipped with a notebook, a nose for fear and no intention of leaving without a headline.

Colin Cable.description: Quiet and precise, Colin understands how information moves through a system and how much people reveal when they think nobody is listening.

Tommy Tech.description: A Brummie microchip obsessive who sees the world as connected systems, fragile circuits and problems waiting to be debugged.

Mandy Modem.description: Fast, elusive and fluent in machines most guests barely understand. Mandy treats locked systems as invitations rather than obstacles.

Barry Byte.description: A slick evangelist for the computer age who always has a brochure, a backup and another deal ready to close.

Peter Packard.description: An early backer of the digital future who understands that information, timing and confidence can be worth more than the hardware itself.

Wanda Wires.description: Quiet, practical and observant, Wanda works under Leo Lights and prefers equipment to celebrity egos.

Glenda Gold.description: Polished, persuasive and dazzlingly well connected. Glenda built an empire from precious stones and treats reputation as her most valuable asset.

Sir Giles Houghton.description: A controlled senior figure accustomed to handling sensitive matters quietly, carefully and well away from public scrutiny.

Graham Greenwell.description: A polished businessman developing a fashionable herbal remedy with Dr. Beverly Steele. He sees markets, packaging and opportunity everywhere.

Felix Fortune.description: A theatrical mystic who speaks in suggestive half-truths and has an uncanny ability to notice when talk of luck makes somebody nervous.

Sasha Smirnoff.description: Elegant, poised and rigorously controlled. Sasha carries herself with the discipline of someone who has crossed borders and survived powerful patrons.

Marianne Moonbeam.description: A free-spirited healer, winemaker and believer in energies that the rest of the room may be too cynical to understand.

Miss Cherry Bomb.description: A beauty-industry entrepreneur selling confidence in glamorous packaging, with the poise of someone who knows exactly how an image is constructed.

Family Solicitor.description: Well-meaning, slightly pompous and not quite as competent as he believes. The family solicitor keeps proceedings official, or at least official-looking.

Tina 'Tank' Thatcher.description: Tough, outspoken and politically charged, with a formidable understanding of power, information and the people who try to control both.

Ronnie Redhand.description: A formidable Welsh woman, recently sacked and in no mood to be diplomatic. Ronnie brings blunt questions, union conviction and a deep distrust of media power.

Johnny 'Jet' Maxwell.description: An ex-punk frontman now running a questionable pub, still carrying the swagger, grudges and survival instincts of the old scene.

Sid Scrape.description: Still angry, still confrontational and deeply suspicious of polished celebrities. Sid wears distrust as naturally as a battered leather jacket.

Ricky Blaze.description: A former screen daredevil who swapped film sets for nightclub doors and collected a lifetime of stories in the process.

Marshall 'Macho' Monroe.description: Patient, imposing and more sensitive about his acting than his size suggests, Marshall knows how to hold a room.

Wendy Woke.description: An uncompromising writer who sees power structures behind every polished image and regards Vale Meridian glamour with ideological suspicion.

'Nev' Neville.description: An intelligent but uneasy systems specialist who sees too many connections, trusts almost nobody and handles every conversation with care.

Agent 'Rosemary'.description: A composed visitor from Cheltenham with excellent observational skills, a talent for blending in and a surprisingly professional interest in surveillance.

Lucien Luxe.description: A stylish New Romantic pop star with an eye for drama, an immaculate public image and a talent for making an entrance.

Penny Page.description: A sharp-witted Vale Meridian script editor who supplies the polished words, spots every missing credit and is ready for recognition.

Polly Premium.description: A retired insurance claims assessor with a sharp eye for small print, a flawless filing system and a polite air of never having been surprised.
